scope: Isolated candidate diagnostics; no production switch. Contains counts and route metadata only.

historicalSuccessfulChild.responseModelNote: The persisted replay metadata contains no responseModel field; absence does not identify the upstream backend.

candidate16384Probe.continuationNote: No owned image or committed source existed; the bounded continuation rule correctly refused a new child.

assetOnlyProbe.purpose: Determine whether the current mapped route can emit an asset tool call with a short task and forced named tool. Returned tool is never executed.
assetOnlyProbe.limitation: Both task length and tool choice changed, so this probe does not isolate their effects. It proves tool-call capability, not completed image/code generation.

fullPromptForcedAssetProbe.purpose: Replay only the recorded input messages and three tool schemas from the 16384 failure, with the baseline 8192 cap and a named first-asset tool choice. No assistant reasoning or output is replayed. Returned tool is never executed.
fullPromptForcedAssetProbe.limitation: This single probe supports named first-tool choice on the unchanged task. It does not prove subsequent code generation or image execution succeeds.

interpretation: The 16384 cap was active; the failure is not explained by an unchanged 8192 parent cap.
The latest task is about half the character length of the historical successful task, with the identical system-message character length.
The configured upstream model remains deepseek-v4.1-flash; hy4-free is an upstream-reported response model, not a configured local alias.
The latest failure occurred before any asset or code tool call, so source validation and image usage checks did not cause that failure.
